decision: Make backend model unused-field review mandatory in the backend-engineer agent instruction.
rationale: Dead model fields create misleading data structures, but fields used by persistence, serialization, or external JSON/API contracts must not be removed without review. The instruction therefore requires repository-wide reference searches, contract checks, tests, and breaking-change assessment before removal.
validation: Validate the OpenCode team configuration, run the shared documentation generator and tests, verify the generated date page contains this entry, and run git diff --check.
impact: Agent workflow only. No production code, tests, or runtime configuration are changed. OpenCode must be restarted to load the updated agent instruction.
